channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: As state funding stalls, medical researchers in Japan pivot to crowdfunding
item.description: Medical campaigns have surged, particularly since the pandemic, when the acute shortage of resources at some hospitals became widely known.

item.title: Nidec scandal sends bonds to bottom in test for new CEO
item.description: The precision motor manufacturer's yen bond due in mid-2032 has slumped to ¥77.7, the lowest among more than 3,000 local corporate notes.

item.title: Japan marks 20 years of tackling human error in public transportation
item.description: The transport safety management system requires transport operators to build and continuously improve their own safety management arrangements.

item.title: Takaichi defends absence from ‘last-minute’ G7 online call after criticism
item.description: A post by the prime minister on social media suggested that short notice and an agenda focused on diesel prices in Europe and the U.S. were factors.

item.title: Data on 130,000 students and teachers possibly exposed, Osaka university says
item.description: Data that may have been exposed includes the names, addresses and email addresses of people linked to the institution, it said.

item.title: Evacuation order to be partially lifted in Fukushima town
item.description: Futaba is one of two municipalities that host Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings' Fukushima No. 1 nuclear power plant.

item.title: Toyota’s ‘baby’ Land Cruiser seen bolstering Asia car sales
item.description: The smallest in its lineup, the new Land Cruiser is doing well both domestically and abroad.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

item.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
item.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

item.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
item.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.
